why: Fix round, one agent, in next/: the recheck found that the window law compared the wire's page size with Rev.ts's, while the door cuts by ledger/Log.ts's, so a page number of Log.ts's own would have stayed green. The new law compares the two names the door and the window import: `PAGE` from ledger/Log.ts and `PAGE` from transport/Wire.ts. It lives in cloudflare/connection.test.ts, a fast test of the platform the door runs on, which already imports ledger/ and transport/; cloudflare/ is not under rule 11 and has no list rows. The gateway's own tests would fire rule 11's import ban on a ledger/ import. The window law is dropped, since the new law holds the claim the window cares about, so WindowMachine.laws.test.ts is again as it was before this ticket's page size fix.
